title: Relationship
description: Reusable entity relationship declared on a Page. Nested metadata for the generator — not a sixth BE-02 first-class entity. one-to-many uses a foreign key on the target; many-to-many requires a join entity and two join foreign keys. Richer parent-child UI catalog remains DEF-05.

cardinality.description: Relationship cardinality used by the T-13 worked examples.

sourceEntity.description: Source / parent entity name, e.g. Project or User.

targetEntity.description: Target / child entity name, e.g. Page or Role.

sourceKey.description: Primary key field on the source entity, typically id.

targetKey.description: Primary key field on the target entity, typically id.

foreignKey.description: Foreign key on the target entity for one-to-many, e.g. Page.projectId.

joinEntity.description: Join / link entity for many-to-many, e.g. UserRole (GSUIF_USER_ROLE).

joinSourceForeignKey.description: Join-table column pointing at the source entity, e.g. userId.

joinTargetForeignKey.description: Join-table column pointing at the target entity, e.g. roleId.
